comment: Menu item names: the panel menu on Host, Host-FX and Host-XL is Block size, Use worker thread and MIDI panic, with a VST Plug-In Technology label. Host-CV's is CLK/N divider, Polyphony channels, Polyphony mode, Panic; Host-Gate's is Velocity mode, Panic; Host-CC has no menu of its own. Plugin search directories and MIDI channel filtering are NOT on the panel menu: the first is on the plugin name's own menu, the second on the expander's display. Block size figures are the maker's manual.
